name: Elpa 301
description: The Elpa 301 is a multi-element HF wire array designed for strong directional performance on the lower HF bands. It uses multiple parallel elements with specific spacing to achieve gain and front-to-back ratio while remaining lightweight and wire-based.
modelingNotes: Multiple parallel elements create directional gain.
Mutual coupling between elements must be modeled accurately.
Height above ground strongly affects takeoff angle.
End effects influence resonant length and impedance.
Ideal for low-band DX where full-size beams are impractical.
